Strategy: With three or fewer feasible bins the rule is Best Fit, but with more bins it scores bins by closeness of the leftover to 20, so crowding changes the preferred bin. The gate can differ from Best Fit only once the bin count exceeds three. It may help by keeping tight bins free when many alternatives exist, or fail because a leftover of 20 is arbitrary and may waste nearly full bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [(-(r - item) if n <= 3 else -abs((r - item) - 20)) for r in bins]
```
